name: Stripe

steps.d: In your Connect settings, enable onboarding accounts with OAuth in the OAuth settings.
Copy the client_id Stripe generates for your platform. Live and test mode have different ones.
List every redirect URL in your platform settings. Stripe uses the first one if you don't send redirect_uri.
Send users to connect.stripe.com/oauth/authorize with response_type=code, your client_id and read_write scope.

blockers.b: OAuth isn't recommended for new platforms
blockers.s: Stripe recommends Connect Onboarding for Standard accounts instead of OAuth.

diffReason: Moderate: Stripe needs a completed platform profile before you can create connected accounts, and recommends Connect Onboarding over OAuth for new platforms

checklist.answer: In your Connect settings, enable onboarding accounts with OAuth in the OAuth settings, then copy your client_id.
OAuth connects Standard accounts. Stripe says OAuth isn't recommended for new Connect platforms and recommends Connect Onboarding instead.
The authorize link needs response_type=code, your client_id and a scope of read_write.
List every redirect URL in your platform settings. If you don't send redirect_uri, Stripe uses the first one you configured.
Stripe generates your client_id. The token request uses your live or test secret API key.
read_write lets your platform act for the connected account, and read_only is the default.
No review is described for OAuth. The platform needs a completed platform profile before you can create connected accounts in the Dashboard.
A test client_id lets you use a non-HTTPS or localhost redirect URI while you test.
